label: A retroactive census has no artifact key to join on (f-iter004-001 still holds) and must rank stand-in signals: the generated description synopsis (prose names the artifact; no extractor exists), authored keywords, the folder slug, and seeded trigger_phrases. The phrase seed is new-packet-only: 195 older specs keep template defaults, the backfill was deferred, and the judge classes those placeholders as template-default (phrase-judge.mjs:91), so phrase/keyword clustering is strongest on post-006 packets and nearly silent on the backlog the 006 census counted (17 recent packets, 6 same-track clusters).

Retroactive grouping is a renumbering event. The rule's move recipe renames the packet into a numbered child and repoints specFolder/specId/parentChain/parent_id and the Spec Folder row (phase-definitions.md:78); git commit c6ee7c77a09 (2026-10-06, 21 packets under four parents) renamed 026-pre-existing-suite-failures to 026-defect-and-hardening-fixes/001-pre-existing-suite-failures and likewise 027->002, 029->003. repair-derived.cjs repairs only disk-derivable facts; refresh-track-roots.mjs rewrites only children_ids and drops entries 'under an earlier identity'; neither repoints manual.depends_on/supersedes/related_to lists nor inbound prose/memory references to the old path — the unsafe residue of any move (inferred; a post-move repo-wide grep for the old path would confirm).

False positives are precedented: the hand regroup produced system-skill-advisor/026-defect-and-hardening-fixes, which groups by outcome not artifact and would not qualify under today's rule (impl-summary:114). A vocabulary-overlap census would propose exactly that shape, and it cannot separate a correction of an existing packet's change from a different change to the same artifact (the line phase-definitions.md:72-74 gates on) because neither is recorded, so candidates must ship with evidence and the correction/change call stays with the operator (006 spec.md:85).

The safe proposal shape is a read-only census following the repair-tool contract — dry-run first, --apply to write, strict exit codes, idempotent (repair-derived.cjs:16, refresh-track-roots.mjs:11) — reporting candidates and never moving a packet; phase 006 deferred a regroup command and auto-backfill and froze the Gate 3 hook text (006 spec.md:82-84). SessionStart is the wrong host (warn-only chain, 5s exec timeout, fail-open: session-start-advisories.ts:48,56,60); the warn-only validator advisory is the precedent (GREP_CONVENTION, 006 spec.md:123; unconsumed health advisory, deltas/iter-004.jsonl:3), and /speckit:plan is a plausible optional entry point since it already carries the series routing (006 spec.md:97).

direction: Auto-applying retroactive grouping (a regroup command that moves packets itself)
reason: Phase 006 deferred a regroup command as premature and every regroup needs an operator decision; the correction-vs-change call is not derivable from metadata (f-iter004-001, f-iter005-003).
SessionStart advisories surface warning text at every startup, give each check a 5s exec timeout and fail open; a full-spec census there is noisy and can silently time out (f-iter005-004).
